stories.title: RBI holds the repo rate at 5.25% (MPC, 3–5 August)
stories.body: neutral stance; FY27 GDP forecast raised to 6.7% and CPI forecast trimmed to 5.0%; Governor Sanjay Malhotra cites resilient demand and easing supply disruptions, with deficient monsoon and volatile crude as risks.

one_liners: RBI holds the repo rate at 5.25% (MPC, 3–5 August) — neutral stance
